name: Song → clip
about: A clip from a song, like the «Song → clip» button, but in parts: scenes on the bars, your own intro, two endings, a short and a long version, a style LoRA, one scene shot again by another model.

data.title: Hero: a photo or a try

data.text:
Song → clip in parts.

1. Upload the song into «Song» and pick the piece: the whole song or the best minute.
2. A line of idea or mood is optional. So is the hero's photo: without it the writer invents the hero, and «Expand» adds their portrait.
3. «Clip writer» → «Write»: scenes on the bars, singing ones and inserts, as the «Song → clip» button makes them.
4. «Expand into scenes»: «Prompt → Scene» chains as long as their bars, frames with the hero, a «Join on the bars» with the song and an «Output».

From then on it is an ordinary graph: put your own intro before the scenes in the «Join», copy the «Join» and the «Output» for a second ending or a short version, connect a style LoRA, give one scene another model.
